label: Character Studio Online Installer
description: Small Git-friendly setup. Downloads the runtime (ComfyUI, Blender, models) then installs.
notes: Set runtimeBundleUrl to an HTTPS link for CharacterStudio-Runtime.zip (built by Publish-RuntimeBundle.ps1).
App code and library come from this Git repo next to the installer.
For a USB/full copy with no download, use the Offline package instead.
